scripts.render: node music.ts 70 && remotion render Demo ../out/demo-raw.mp4 && ffmpeg -y -v error -i ../out/demo-raw.mp4 -c:v copy -af loudnorm=I=-14:TP=-1.5:LRA=11 -ar 48000 -c:a aac -b:a 192k ../out/demo.mp4
scripts.render:120: node music.ts 70 && REMOTION_FPS=120 remotion render Demo ../out/demo-120-raw.mp4 --bundle-cache=false && ffmpeg -y -v error -i ../out/demo-120-raw.mp4 -c:v copy -af loudnorm=I=-14:TP=-1.5:LRA=11 -ar 48000 -c:a aac -b:a 192k ../out/demo-120fps.mp4
